title: Why does more vocabulary lower agreement?
question: Is the fragmentation caused by the number of classes, by FIBO's particular classes, or by declaring types at all?
hypothesis: Declaring a type pushes the extractor toward specific, idiosyncratic instance names, so typed entities are less findable across views than untyped ones.
still_needed: type findability, no-ontology against FIBO, paired by case
a control condition with seventy non-FIBO classes
